reuse.F551: stableCapturedJSON and external pinned-file/hash discipline; no bulk price parser executed.
reuse.F568: Exact native contractId/symbol/asset/currency/status matching semantics and saved-scope reconciliation; no production source replay, prices or CORE review.
reuse.F552_negative: Existing isExactSavedNonTargetDecision proof+five-field tuple validator. Future caller supplies complete frozen current negatives, not only historical380.
reuse.future_new_identity_review: Existing generateSavedNativeBindingProposals may be consumed later only with independent primary economic proof and explicit ROOT review; not called here.

input_contract.external_file_gate: Before invoking consumer, ROOT-admitted future wrapper pins exact private capture bytes/SHA/size and frozen input files following F551. This function validates expected snapshot/body digests; it neither verifies an external admission nor creates one.

digest_bases.body_sha256: SHA256(JSON.stringify(snapshot.body) UTF8), ROOT parsed JSON serialization, not wire bytes.
digest_bases.snapshot_json_sha256: SHA256(JSON.stringify(snapshot) UTF8); full snapshot with original producer clocks/receipt.
digest_bases.saved_scope_and_negatives: SHA256(stableCapturedJSON(parsed array) UTF8), distinct from original file byte SHA.

input_contract.selected_scope: 550 existing ROOT-accepted saved-scope F552 proposal records with tuple/native_contract_id/native_status_at_capture; exact digest required. Matching is saved membership, not new crypto/CORE proof.
input_contract.negative_decisions: Complete existing frozen exact-negative decisions with their original proof, digest-pinned; changed tuples or statuses do not inherit a prior negative decision.
input_contract.hash_callback: Frozen synchronous SHA256 function as in F551/F568, no IO.

evidence_modes.OBSERVED: Matching reader byte/clock/pin flags, OBSERVED record and BOUND_SAVED_NATIVE_CATALOG_AT_ORIGINAL_RECEIPT status required.
evidence_modes.ARTIFICIAL_PREPARATION: Only explicitly ARTIFICIAL record and BOUND_CATALOG_NON_OBSERVED_NOT_NATIVE, source_response_bound=false; cannot become native evidence.

output_contract.unknown_review_status: PROPOSAL / NOT_CHECKED; no classifier inference from language/name/status alone.
output_contract.counts_basis: Only a future admitted exact capture passed through the consumer. No counts evaluated by F616.
output_contract.batch_handoff: ROOT may split only PROPOSAL rows into finite <=25-tuple review batches using row_index+tuple hash+capture digests. Independent primary identity/class evidence still required; no automatic activation.

prepared_example_status_only.reason: NO_NEW_ACTUAL_OBSERVED_CAPTURE; do not fill from historical1278 or prior1294/249 summary.

old_fixture.synthetic_snapshot_wrapper_if_prepared_l: Must be explicitly ARTIFICIAL_PREPARATION, preserving genuine old body/receipt/receive; never relabel as new OBSERVED.

finite_consumer_cases_for_future_separat: Exact new OBSERVED capture+trusted digests yields metadata only; saved membership/negative/proposal row counts partition the original array.
Altered body/full snapshot/receipt/clock/pin or frozen scope/negative digest rejects before output.
Non-OBSERVED record rejects default mode; explicit ARTIFICIAL wrapper stays preparation only with current_N=null.
Unicode/native numeric-prefix symbol is preserved exactly without language, prefix multiplier or ticker-only identity inference.
New/changed status1 USDT tuple stays PROPOSAL/NOT_CHECKED; changed negative tuple does not inherit old classification.
Duplicate native symbol or contractId blocks all colliding row promotion; invalid/non-USDT/inactive and owner exclusions remain separate.
No IO/source replay/CORE/units/maps import and no prices/raw exports.
own_release: Follows freeze; exact CAS/FULL release reported separately.
